integrity: Exact all-rank proof is analytic; independently measured finite ridge volumes and asymptotic numerical checks corroborate rather than replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic curvature exchange is proved only for bounded standardized central ranks; no first-order sign at the critical boundary, no claims for weighted hypersimplices.
title: A Gaussian rank-window curvature crossover and exact second intrinsic volumes of hypersimplices
